fullDescription: A high-tech, dark-mode multimedia repository dashboard titled 'Content Lab'. The aesthetic is defined by a deep navy and slate palette (#0f172a) punctuated by a vibrant mustard yellow accent (#d97706). It features a modern neumorphic design language with soft shadows and inset depths, coupled with glassmorphic overlays. The layout uses a 12-column grid system featuring a persistent left-hand navigation/file explorer and a large-scale 'digital frame' preview monitor. This style is ideally suited for SaaS asset management, technical control rooms, fintech dashboards, and creative studio repositories.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark navy dashboard for multimedia asset management, utilizing tactile neumorphic effects, a central digital frame for file previews, and editorial typography with high-contrast mustard accents.

style.description: The style essence combines Neumorphism (soft UI) with high-tech functionalism. It uses 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for bold, editorial headings and 'DM Sans' for clean legibility. The color scheme relies on deep dark navy (#0f172a) for the background, with layers of shadows (#020617 and #1e293b) to create depth. Accent elements use a rich mustard yellow (#d97706) for call-to-actions and active states. Interactions include smooth scaling, translation on hover, and inner-glow reflections on the digital frame component.
style.prompt: Create a UI design with a background color of #0f172a. Use a two-tiered typography system: 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for headers (font-weights: 700, 800) and 'DM Sans' for body text (weights: 400, 500). Implement neumorphic effects using two shadow types: Flat (8px 8px 16px #020617, -8px -8px 16px rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4)) and Inset (inset 6px 6px 12px #020617, inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4)). Use an accent color of #d97706 for critical highlights and active indicators. Primary buttons and active badges should have a subtle inner glow (inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)). UI elements should have rounded corners ranging from 16px (small icons) to 32px (large panels/cards). Animation transitions should be 300ms using a standard ease-in-out curve, except for large preview scales which should use a 1000ms duration.

layout_and_structure.description: A structured dashboard layout with a top-level header, a horizontal stats strip, and a two-column main workspace (4:8 ratio) for navigation and preview.

prompts.prompt: A max-width 7xl container. Left side: Logo container (neumorph-flat) with a 40x40px mustard icon box and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' bold uppercase text. Right side: Administrator profile badge with a circular avatar inside an inset neumorphic ring and dual-line text metadata (light gray #4B5563 for labels).

A 4-column grid of equal-width cards. Each card uses 'neumorph-inset' styling with 32px corner radius. Layout includes a top label in tiny (10px) all-caps font-weight 800 with 0.25em tracking, followed by a large (3xl) value. One card should highlight status using an emerald-500 color.

prompts.partPt: File Menu do Topo Menu Lateral
prompts.prompt: Occupying 4/12 of the grid. Title section with a 'Filter' dropdown link in mustard yellow. Vertical scrollable area containing file cards. Active card state: 'neumorph-inset' background, border color #d97706 at 30% opacity, and a vertical 1.5px x 40px mustard pill indicator on the far left edge. Inactive cards: 'neumorph-flat' that lifts slightly on hover.

Occupying 8/12 of the grid. Features a large 'digital-frame' container: 28px border radius, background #020617, 1px solid #1e293b border, and a subtle top-left to bottom-right white gradient overlay (5% opacity) to mimic glass. Inside, a content 'screen' with 'neumorph-inset-deep' styling. Center includes a 112x112px floating glassmorphic play button (backdrop-blur-xl, white/10 border). Bottom contains a floating glassmorphic metadata panel with blurred background and dual-column technical details (Resolution, Elapsed Time).

special_ui_components.description: Tactile accent button with shadow and inner highlight.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply background #d97706, border-radius 12px-24px depending on size. Box shadow: 4px 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4). Inner shadow: inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2). Text should be white or #0f172a for maximum contrast.

special_ui_components.description: A floating info card with heavy background blur and semi-transparent borders.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background color: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.8). Backdrop-filter: blur(24px). Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Border-radius: 32px. Padding: 32px. Elements inside use high-contrast white text for titles and mustard (#d97706) for micro-labels.
